previous_statement: Uniform square estimate from the registered H-CB/extended-C*-algebra definitions: there are universal K_sq<infinity and e_sq>0 such that, for every permitted datum with e<=e_sq, every n>=1, and every Z in M_n tensor S_P, ||Z^dagger dot Z|| >= (1-K_sq e)||Z||^2.
new_statement: Corrected uniform square estimate on the branches justified by the allowed inputs: take K_sq=C_ca and e_sq=e_ca. For every permitted datum with e<=e_sq and nonvanishing P, every n>=1 and Z in M_n tensor S_P satisfy ||Z^dagger dot Z|| >= (1-K_sq e)||Z||^2. If S_P=0, the same inequality is vacuous. No estimate is asserted here for a hypothetical datum with P vanishing but S_P nonzero, since the allowed inputs do not establish that this branch is impossible.
